episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: San Yeong lives a rough life with her mother. She encounters Hae Sang, who warns her that she is possessed and that people around her will die.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: San Yeong sees a ghost for the first time. As she receives a call from a dead child, she finds out the truth behind the cries of a girl from the call.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: San Yeong and Hae Sang arrive in the new city where Jangjin-ri searched for clues. They witness a shadow of a tree with dead bodies hanging from it.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Unknown numbers related to evil spirits flow out of San Yeong's mouth. San Yeong and Hae Sang search about the numbers and arrive at Baekchagol Village.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: San Yeong hears a story from Gyeong Mun on why she had no choice but to leave Gang Mo. Hae Sang feels that there is a secret hidden in Baekchagol Village.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hae Sang takes the piece of blue pottery to his grandmother, Byeong Hui. San Yeong is enraged to learn that Gyeong Mun received Seok Ran's inheritance.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: San Yeong and Hae Sang are no longer able to trust each other. Hae Sang faces a shocking truth after hearing a startling story from Eun Myung.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: San Yeong has no choice but to accept Gang Mo's decision. Meanwhile, Hae Sang is in despair after realising the truth and heads to Baekchagol Village.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hong Sae meets San Yeong, who has turned into an evil spirit, which leads him to start questioning the identity of the spirit.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: San Yeong and Hae Sang chase after the remaining two items to identify the evil spirit's real name when San Yeong starts to exhibit bizarre behaviour.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The three find out the evil spirit's name. Hae Sang retrieves the last jade hairpin and brings it to San Yeong, only to find that she has disappeared.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: San Yeong's shadow returns to its original state. Gyeong Mun begs for the return of San Yeong when the evil spirit makes her a dangerous offer.
